name: Cinematic landscape, vertical
note: Aerial and water. Wide ranges on purpose: this footage is bright, slow and smooth, and a brief written for a nightclub would reject all of it. Cuts on bars where the music is loud, long holds where it is not.

coherence.note: Effectively off: the set is already curated to one world, so clustering could only discard material.

callbacks.note: Two, not six. With 36 clips there is no need to repeat, and repetition was a complaint.

subject: a mountain range
a forest
a field of grass
a sunset sky
a river
subject_note: Every brief names its world. Without one they all draw from the same pool, and two briefs differing only in pacing produced 94% the same cuts AND 95% the same shots -- which bench/cutscore.py --brief-swap caught.
